name: Titan Company Ltd

ledger.quote: So far we are seeing a very steady traction. The hesitation that we had and we launched it even before 9 carat was hallmarked. Meaning announcement of hallmarked happened immediately. But we have been seeing a steady growth of this. There are people who are buying the jewellery, 9 carat notwithstanding, diamond jewellery and pretty comfortable with this. And we didn't see any resistance at all whether it's online or offline. So our view is that with the gold price increasing, all those earlier resistance of customers towards karatage. I think especially in the lower segment which is not more on the adornment space, less on the let's say investment space, I think it's going to be the way. And we are banking on it and therefore we are expanding it. In fact, we just decided that we'll be taking it to all 300 stores very soon.
ledger.speaker: Saumen Bhaumik
ledger.verdict: Management provided no update on expanding 9 carat jewellery to 300 stores during the call.

ledger.quote: 11 to 11.5 still remains our guidance on which we are trying to work on.
ledger.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
ledger.verdict: Full-year FY26 jewellery EBIT margin results were omitted on the call and in reported financials.

ledger.quote: I think we are hopeful that mid-teen kind of number we should be able to deliver full year basis for FY ‘26. Yes.
ledger.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
ledger.verdict: Full-year FY26 watch EBIT margin was not disclosed, though Q1 FY26 margin reached 18.6%.
ledger.evidence: Last Quarter 1 FY '26 watch EBIT margin was 18.6% compared to 17.8% normalized margin for this quarter.

ledger.quote: So as far as our growth outlook is concerned, we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
ledger.speaker: N. S. Raghavan
ledger.verdict: Full-year FY26 growth figures for the eyecare division were not provided on the earnings call.

ledger.quote: On watches, last time also, we have talked and that they will gradually revert towards 16%, 17% band. And on a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.
ledger.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
ledger.verdict: Normalized watch EBIT margin reached 17.8% in Q1 FY27, holding above the 15-16% target band.
ledger.evidence: Last Quarter 1 FY '26 watch EBIT margin was 18.6% compared to 17.8% normalized margin for this quarter.

ledger.quote: So I expect that overall margin, we had -- if you remember, a couple of quarters back, we had said that, gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin.
ledger.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
ledger.verdict: CaratLane reached a 9.6% EBIT margin in Q1 FY27, progressing towards double-digit margin targets.
ledger.evidence: So they have delivered 9.6%, I think something like that, 9% upwards. So their normal trajectory should be towards 10%.

ledger.quote: So from a volume growth standpoint, it is more or less within our zone. This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth. So this is what we will continue to deliver.
ledger.speaker: N. S. Raghavan
ledger.verdict: Management did not report specific volume growth figures for the eyecare division on the call.

ledger.quote: our objective currently is very soon to scale up to the next step of 10 to 12 stores and then kind of see how that works for us before planning a national launch.
ledger.speaker: Arun Narayan
ledger.verdict: No status update was given regarding scaling up to 10-12 stores in Quarter 1.

ledger.quote: So, we are not lowballing. We said this is the medium to three to five-year horizon if you want to look at. This is the growth rate we are expecting.
ledger.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
ledger.verdict: Management reaffirmed double-digit growth trajectory aligned with its three to five-year target horizon.
ledger.evidence: overall, medium to long term, we have always said that a good strong double-digit growth.

open.quote: Overall, long term, growth is on a very strong wicket, but the normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.
open.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

read: Management maintains strong operational delivery in key growth areas like watches and CaratLane while consistently target-setting for the long term. However, accountability is weaker on segment-specific commitments in eyecare and retail store expansions.
questions: What was the full-year FY26 growth achieved in the eyecare division against the 13-14% target?
Has the expansion of 9-carat jewellery across 300 stores been completed as previously planned?
Did the company achieve the target scale-up to 10-12 test stores in Quarter 1?
bull: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 29.3% YoY to Rs 21,356 crore with EBITDA margin expanding to 14.0%.
Normalized watch EBIT margin reached 17.8% in Q1 FY27, maintaining strong profitability above 15%.
CaratLane achieved a 9.6% EBIT margin in Q1 FY27, approaching its double-digit margin target.
bear: Total borrowings stood high at Rs 30,621 crore with a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.95.
Management provided no full-year FY26 segment margin performance details for the core jewellery business.
Normalized jewellery EBIT margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 10.9%, slightly below the 11% benchmark.
